
=== header

  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

=== intro

  Welcome! HA NOVA lets your AI assistant run your Home Assistant.

  Steps: pick your AI app, find Home Assistant, add the NOVA App, connect this computer, add the skills.
  When a browser page opens, finish there and come back here.
  You need the Home Assistant owner's account.
  Home Assistant Link only: the NOVA App must already be installed.

=== step

  [2/4] Step 2 of 4 – Connect this computer

=== discovery results
  [ok] Found Home Assistant at ha.lan (mDNS)
  [!] Found Home Assistant as homeassistant.local
    This name can stop working, mostly on Windows. Type its IP address below instead.
    Find it in Home Assistant: Settings → System → Network.
  [ok] Found Home Assistant at 10.0.0.2
  [!] Didn't find Home Assistant by itself. Starting from your saved address 10.0.0.3
  [!] Didn't find Home Assistant by itself. Type its address.

=== complete: one client

  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

  [ok] Setup complete!

  Installed for: Claude Code
  Claude Code is the claude command in a terminal and the Code tab in the Claude Desktop app (in a new chat). The chat tab in Claude Desktop doesn't use it. For that tab, see chat apps (needs Home Assistant reachable from the internet).
  Chat apps guide: https://github.com/markusleben/ha-nova/blob/main/docs/reference/chat-apps.md

  Open Claude Code and try asking:

    "Turn off the living room light"
    "List my automations"

  Need help? Run: ha-nova doctor

  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

  [ok] Setup complete!

  Installed for: Hermes Agent

  Your home: 3 devices.

  Open Hermes Agent and try asking:

    "What's in my home?"
    "List my automations"

  Unlocking a lock or opening a gate or garage door waits for your own confirmation; a plain yes in chat isn't enough.

=== already done: legacy token

  HA NOVA Setup
  -------------

  [ok] Everything is already set up!

  This computer still uses the old shared access.
  The next HA NOVA release won't accept it.
  Run ha-nova setup again any time to switch. It takes a minute.

  Run 'ha-nova doctor' to check everything.

=== incomplete: generic

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  HA NOVA saved your setup, but it isn't ready yet.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.


=== incomplete: relay_unreachable

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  HA NOVA saved your setup, but couldn't reach the NOVA App yet.
  In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons) and start it.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.


=== incomplete: ws_degraded

  [!!] Setup incomplete

  The NOVA App answers, but it isn't connected to Home Assistant yet.
  In Home Assistant, open Settings → Apps → NOVA Relay (older Home Assistant: Settings > Add-ons). Check its settings, then restart it.
  Then run "ha-nova setup" again — it continues where you left off.
